epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer challenged option A: 「打印醒目的警告，打印在哪里？管理员也不知道啊」 (2026-11-04). That is right, so the seat withdraws A as written.

## Why A falls short

A boot message reaches only whoever reads the terminal or the container log. The administrator who owns the data signs in to the Console, and may not be the person who deployed. Read on `main` `987ff33b88`:

- The Setup `System Overview` dashboard (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/dashboards/system_overview.dashboard.ts`) shows users, organizations, sessions, packages and audit counts, and nothing about the deployment.
- `/api/v1/auth/config` names no email delivery state (#30107).
- A search of `ui/packages/app-shell/src` for a banner component by the usual names found none. The Console's only first-run prompt seen is the time zone dialog.
- The 2026-08-25 ruling for a walled owner who cannot verify, "warn loudly, by name, at boot; NEVER refuse", is also log-only, so it has the same blind spot.

## Revised option

- **A2. Tell both people, where each of them looks.**
  - Boot log for the deployer, as in A.
  - For administrators only, a standing notice on the Console home page and at the top of Setup's System Overview: what is at risk, in business words, with a copy button for the three variables to send to whoever deployed it.
  - It does not interrupt with a dialog, and it stays until the condition is gone.
  - It shows in production mode only. Members never see it. The state is served to administrators only and not on the public config.
  - Contents: database on a local file, sign-in secret and credential key self-generated. Local file storage and no email service are shown as lower-severity lines, and the email line can share its signal with #30107.

Options B (refuse) and C (leave) stand as written.

## Limits

The server cannot tell whether its disk survives a restart, so the notice has to say "if this disk is not kept". A deliberate single-machine install will see it until the variables are set; whether an administrator may acknowledge and hide it is part of the decision.

## Recommendation: A2

Still awaiting the maintainer's decision.

epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer asked: 「是否建议生产环境拒绝启动？」 (2026-11-04). The seat's answer: not across the board, yes in the official container image. Read on `main` `987ff33b88`; the image itself was not run, because Docker is not running on this machine.

## Why not refuse everywhere

- `packages/cli/src/commands/start.ts:481`: `os start` sets `NODE_ENV=production` when it is unset. So the zero-config trial is itself "production mode", and a refusal keyed on the mode would end `npm run start` on a laptop.
- `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx:253` documents SQLite on a single small host with a volume as a supported choice. A local file is not wrong in itself.

## Why refuse in the image

- `docker/Dockerfile` sets `NODE_ENV=production` and runs `os start`, and `docker/README.md:95` says "You must inject at runtime: `OS_DATABASE_URL`, `OS_AUTH_SECRET`, `OS_SECRET_KEY`". That is declared and, from the code path, not enforced: `start.ts` generates the secrets itself. Under the enforce-or-remove rule, the declaration should hold.
- A container's disk is what gets replaced, so a self-generated secret there is the case with the worst outcome.
- A refusal at boot costs least: nothing has been written, and the operator is watching the deploy.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts:4845` already refuses a production boot with no auth secret. The refusal text and the idea exist; only the `start` wrapper steps around them.

## Revised option

- **A3 = A2 plus a narrow B.**
  - The official image refuses to start unless all three variables are set explicitly, naming the missing ones. An explicit `OS_DATABASE_URL=file:…` on a volume passes, so SQLite stays a choice.
  - Everywhere else `os start` keeps booting, with the boot log and the administrator notice of A2.

How the image signals this, for example an image `ENV` that `start` reads, is for the dev.

## Cost

A deployment already running the image with self-generated secrets on a volume would stop at upgrade. It has to export those values first, from the home directory's `auth-secret` and `dev-crypto-key`, and the refusal text has to say so. Whether any such deployment exists was not measured. Per the startup posture, the seat does not propose a staged window unless a named user needs one.

## Recommendation: A3

Still awaiting the maintainer's decision, including whether an administrator may acknowledge and hide the notice.

epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

**Ruling recorded: option A3.** The maintainer, verbatim, in the direct session on 2026-11-04: 「同意」, answering the seat's recommendation on this card.

- **Official container image:** refuses to start unless `OS_DATABASE_URL`, `OS_AUTH_SECRET` and `OS_SECRET_KEY` are all set explicitly, and names the missing ones. An explicit `OS_DATABASE_URL=file:…` passes. The refusal text says how a deployment running on self-generated secrets exports them first.
- **Every other `os start`:** keeps booting, with a boot log block for the deployer.
- **Administrators, production mode only:** a standing notice on the Console home page and at the top of Setup's System Overview, with a copy button for the variables. No dialog. Members never see it, and the state is not on the public config. Local file storage and no email service are lower-severity lines; the email line may share its signal with #30107.

**Sub-question, read as the seat's stated recommendation:** an administrator may acknowledge and hide the notice. The hide is written to the audit log, and System Overview keeps one small line. The maintainer's word did not separately name this point, so if they say otherwise, their word replaces this line.

The dev verifies the image path in a real container, because the seat could not: Docker was not running on the seat's machine, and the claim that the image boots without the variables comes from reading the code. If that premise is false, report a fork.

Left for triage to route. No lane or claim is set here.
